nodes.name: Mark start
nodes.notes: Remembers when this run began and what started it (for the run duration and trigger).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { idle: true, n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id) } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.finished', workflow_key: 'deadline-monitor', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: $json.status, result: $json.result, error: $json.error, duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - $('Mark start').first().json._t0) }) }}
